items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: But there was a guy named Joe Bari in the outfit with us in Seckenheim, and Barry is the grandfather’s name with Tony Bennett, I mean that was Tony. He was in the Army.

ctx.x: Was there much mixing with the German population?

Not an awful lot. We dated a few German gals at the time. But there was a guy named Joe Bari in the outfit with us in Seckenheim, and Barry is the grandfather’s name with Tony Bennett, I mean that was Tony. He was in the Army. And I said, “why did you go in the Army under the name of Joe Bari?” Well at the time there was a little bit of racial thing with the Italians back in those days. And then to go into the Army as Anthony D. Benedetto, he figured it would be easy as just Joe Bari. So he went under the name of…
I’ll be darned. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
